name: Susan Overman
prior_offices: Weston County treasurer (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Susan Overman, also listed as Susie Overman in official February 4, 2025, commissioners minutes, is the Weston County treasurer and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The News Letter Journal reported that she was unopposed in the August 2026 Republican primary.

sources.name: News Letter Journal, Weston County certifies 2026 primary results
